standing_user_rules: ZERO Under markets allowed — strictly OVER Corners, OVER Fouls, OVER Tackles, OVER Cards, OVER Shots/SOT
ZERO Goal markets allowed (no Over/Under Goals, no BTTS)
REAL Bookmaker Line Rule — never quote theoretical lines below the bookmaker's actual published window
Zero sugar-coating — always audit BOTH Home and Away match-by-match logs before kick-off

rules.title: STRICT OVER-ONLY BEHAVIOUR POLICY (Zero Under Markets, Zero Goal Markets)
rules.example: Friday 23 Oct Global Scan (29 Matches -> 6-Leg 3.036x Pure OVER Slip)
rules.whatPublicSees: Mixing sweat-inducing Under lines (where 1 red card or 85th-minute scramble ruins the entire rollover) or 1X2 / Goal bets.
rules.whatMachineSees: Goals and Under lines carry asymmetric late-game chaos risk. Pure OVER behaviour lines (Team/Match Corners Over, Fouls Over, Tackles Over, Yellow Cards Over, Shots Over) only move in ONE direction — upward every minute the match continues.
rules.howToProfit: Exclude ALL Goal markets and ALL Under markets from every rollover slip. Back ONLY verified 90%–100% OVER behaviour floors.

rules.badge: ACTIVE RULE #2 • REAL BOOKIE LINE RULE
rules.title: Audit ONLY Real Published Bookmaker Lines (Never Quote Imaginary Low Lines)
rules.example: Granada vs Valladolid (Bookie Fouls = 29.5, NOT 20.5) vs Stuttgart vs Gladbach (22Bet Fouls = Over 18.5 @ 1.31 ✅)
rules.whatPublicSees: Seeing that a high-foul league hits Over 20.5 in 95% of games and assuming the bookmaker offers Over 20.5 — when oddsmakers actually open Granada/Valladolid at 29.5 (where hit rate is 50%).
rules.whatMachineSees: Out of all 29 matches on 23 Oct, oddsmakers priced 28 Fouls markets right on their true mean (24.5–30.5). ONLY Stuttgart vs Gladbach was mispriced on 22Bet at Over 18.5 @ 1.31 against a 23.4 expectation (13/13 = 100% >= 21 fouls since Sept 5).
rules.howToProfit: Reject inflated bookmaker lines immediately with zero sugar-coating. Strike ONLY where the actual live bookmaker line sits +2.5 to +5.0 below both teams' real floor.

rules.title: Two-Team Study Catches Single-Team Foul Traps (Filter #3)
rules.example: VfB Stuttgart vs Gladbach — Rejected Gladbach Away Fouls Over 10.5 @ 1.42 in Favour of Match Fouls Over 18.5 @ 1.31
rules.whatPublicSees: Gladbach committed 13, 17, 12, 16, 14, 13 fouls (6/6 = 100% Over 10.5!) so one-sided bettors jump on Gladbach Over 10.5 @ 1.42.
rules.whatMachineSees: Stuttgart draw 11+ opponent fouls in only 5/9 games (55.6%) and 2/4 at home! Literally 3 days earlier (20 Oct), Atlético Madrid committed only 7 fouls at Stuttgart (Away O10.5 LOST), yet Stuttgart committed 15 so Match Fouls = 22 (Over 18.5 WON by +3.5!).
rules.howToProfit: Always inspect BOTH Team For AND Opponent Drawn logs. Taking Match Fouls Over 18.5 @ 1.31 turned a 73.3% trap into a 13/13 (100% since Sept 5) lock.

rules.badge: ACTIVE RULE #4 • REFEREE + AWAY CARD FLOOR
rules.title: Three-Way Booking Lock: Team 100% Floor + Venue + Assigned Referee
rules.example: Granada vs Real Valladolid — Valladolid (Away) Over 1.5 Yellow Cards @ 1.24 (Ref: Marta Huerta de Aza)
rules.whatPublicSees: Guessing Match Total Cards without checking which team commits the tactical away fouls or who holds the whistle.
rules.whatMachineSees: Real Valladolid hit 2+ yellows in 10/10 games (100% season: 4,2,4,3,5,2,2,4,4,2) averaging 3.8 yellows AWAY (4,5,4,4,2), AND assigned referee Marta Huerta de Aza booked EVERY away team 3+ times (3, 3, 5 = 3/3 = 100%) in 2026–27 Segunda División.
rules.howToProfit: Require Team Season 100% + Away Venue alignment + verified Referee card floor before touching any booking prop.

rules.title: Evidence-Based Self-Learning: Filter #4 (0-Point Under Ban) Permanently Deleted
rules.example: 54-Match UEFA Ledger Audit (Tue UCL + Wed UCL + Thu UEL/UECL)
rules.whatPublicSees: Keeping a gut-feel rule forever without testing whether it actually saves losses.
rules.whatMachineSees: Post-mortem across all 54 UEFA matches proved Filter #4 saved 0 losses while blocking 7 clean winners (including Fenerbahçe vs Slavia 4 cards, Celtic vs Salzburg 24 fouls, Ararat vs AZ 24 fouls). Deleted permanently.
rules.howToProfit: Every rule is audited against real FT outcomes in model_evaluation_ledger.csv. Rules that don't improve net hit rate are deleted immediately.

rules.title: SportyBet vs 22Bet Execution Split (+0.07 to +0.14 Per Leg Matters in Rollovers)
rules.example: Go Ahead Eagles O4.5 Corners (1.31 SportyBet vs 1.20 22Bet) vs Stuttgart Fouls O18.5 (1.31 ONLY on 22Bet)
rules.whatPublicSees: Losing 20%–35% of rollover payout to shaved odds or forcing weak legs when one bookie hasn't opened props yet.
rules.whatMachineSees: SportyBet pays higher on pure Corners, while 22Bet opens discounted alt Fouls lines (Over 18.5 @ 1.31) and Italian Serie B team corners (Vicenza Over 2.5 @ ~1.15) that let us drop 83% legs entirely.
rules.howToProfit: Shop lines across SportyBet & 22Bet and eliminate every sub-90% leg before locking Day 1 (6 events = 3.036x, 100% >= 90% floor).
